description: Na₂Tb(MoO₄)(PO₄) crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibca space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.57 Å. Tb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Tb-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.46 Å. Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.79 Å) and two longer (1.81 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Tb and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Tb and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tb, and one P atom.
